entities.summary: Guerrilla war waged between 1981 and 1986 in uganda by the national resistance army (nra) under the leadership of yoweri museveni against the government of milton obote, and later that of tito okello Took place in Uganda. Date: 1980-10-06. Ended: 1986-01-25.
